relationships.subject: ELF1
relationships.evidence_quote: This upregulation was triggered by nerve injury-induced increase in DRG ELF1, a transcription factor that bound to the NIS-lncRNA promoter.

relationships.subject: NIS-lncRNA
relationships.evidence_quote: Mimicking NIS-lncRNA upregulation elevated CCL2 expression, increased CCL2-mediated excitability in DRG neurons, and produced neuropathic pain symptoms.

relationships.subject: NIS-lncRNA
relationships.evidence_quote: NIS-lncRNA recruited more binding of the RNA-interacting protein FUS to the Ccl2 promoter and augmented Ccl2 transcription in injured DRGs.

relationships.subject: NIS-lncRNA
relationships.evidence_quote: Taken together, our findings strongly suggest that upregulated NIS-lncRNA in injured DRGs is required for neuropathic pain development and maintenance.

key_findings: Nerve injury upregulates DRG NIS-lncRNA via ELF1; NIS-lncRNA promotes FUS-dependent Ccl2 transcription
Knockdown of NIS-lncRNA attenuates, and overexpression produces, neuropathic pain-like behavior
